mapper.select: SELECT id, comment_id AS commentId, user_id AS userId, parent_reply_id AS parentReplyId, content, like_count AS likeCount, dislike_count AS dislikeCount, created_at AS createdAt FROM anime_comment_reply WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, comment_id AS commentId, user_id AS userId, parent_reply_id AS parentReplyId, content, like_count AS likeCount, dislike_count AS dislikeCount, created_at AS createdAt FROM anime_comment_reply WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO anime_comment_reply(comment_id, user_id, parent_reply_id, content, like_count, dislike_count, created_at) VALUES(#{commentId}, #{userId}, #{parentReplyId}, #{content}, 0, 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE anime_comment_reply SET content = #{content} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE anime_comment_reply SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE anime_comment_reply SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE anime_comment_reply SET dislike_count = dislike_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE anime_comment_reply SET dislike_count = GREATEST(dislike_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
